blocks.passage: »Das ist ___ Kunsthalle. Das ist ein Museum.«
blocks.explanationEnglish: Kunsthalle is feminine. Feminine nouns take the article die.

concept.title: Artikel: der, die, das
concept.rule: Every noun has an article: der (masculine), die (feminine) or das (neuter).

Das ist ___ Kirche. Das ist das Rathaus.

blocks.explanationEnglish: kein replaces ein and eine in a negative sentence. It works for all three genders.

concept.title: Negationsartikel kein
concept.rule: kein replaces ein and eine in a negative sentence with a noun.

blocks.prompt: Match the German direction to the English word:
blocks.explanationEnglish: These three words describe a direction. The verb gehen says to move on foot.

concept.title: Richtungen
concept.rule: links = left, rechts = right, geradeaus = straight ahead.

blocks.explanationEnglish: The imperative starts with the verb. Sie is the polite form. The period goes at the end.

concept.title: Imperativ mit Sie
concept.rule: A polite order starts with the verb, then Sie.

blocks.passage: »Das Konzert ist im ___ . Es ist der siebte Monat.«
blocks.explanationEnglish: Juli is the seventh month of the year. Juni is the sixth and August is the eighth.

concept.title: Monate
concept.rule: German has twelve months. Juli is the seventh month.

blocks.prompt: Fill the gap with the correct word:
blocks.explanationEnglish: Adjectives after sein stay in their plain form. They take no ending.

concept.title: Adjektiv mit sein
concept.rule: Adjectives after sein stay in their plain form with no ending.
